name: Pectoral Sandpiper
desc: Pectoral Sandpiper (Calidris melanotos): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The pectoral sandpiper, often abbreviated pec, is a small, migratory wader that breeds in arctic regions of North America and Asia, wintering in South America and Oceania. It eats small invertebrates.
